question.:question/problem:
If
$S=[\begin{aligned}5+6p & -7+p \\ 8 & 5\end{aligned}]$
and $det(S)=59$, what is the value of $p?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
For a $2\times 2$ matrix, the determinant is given by the formula

$$
|\begin{aligned}a & b \\ c & d\end{aligned}|=ad-bc.
$$

Using the formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(S) & =|\begin{aligned}5+6p & -7+p \\ 8 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =(5+6p)\cdot 5-(-7+p)\cdot 8 \\  & =25+30p+56-8p \\  & =81+22p\end{aligned}
$$

Since $det(S)=59$, we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(S) & =59 \\ 81+22p & =59 \\ 22p & =59-81 \\ 22p & =-22 \\ p & =-1\end{aligned}
$$
